# volcano_frontend (Resource)

A deployed Next.js frontend. There is no update endpoint for this resource - every attribute change replaces it (this includes redeploying with new source, which the API only exposes as a brand-new frontend plus a domain re-attach, not an in-place code swap).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_frontend" "web" {
  project_id = volcano_project.example.id
  name       = "web"
  source     = "${path.module}/dist/web.zip"
  framework  = "nextjs"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `source` (String) Path to a local zip or tar.gz archive of the frontend project directory or monorepo workspace root.

### Optional

- `app_root` (String) Relative POSIX path from the archive root to the Next.js app to build, e.g. apps/web.
- `framework` (String)
- `variable_scope` (String)
- `variables` (List of String) Project variable names selected when variable_scope is scoped.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `deployed_regions` (List of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `site_url` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_frontend.web <project-id>,<frontend-id>
```
